# Vendored graphics runtimes

These files are unmodified official distributions, kept local for offline runtime specimens.

- D3 7.9.0: `d3.v7.9.0.min.js`; ISC; source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/d3/-/d3-7.9.0.tgz; license: `D3-LICENSE.txt`.
- Three.js r186 / npm 0.186.0: `three.r186.module.js` plus its unmodified local `three.core.js` import; MIT; source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.0.tgz; license: `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
- p5.js 2.3.1: `p5.v2.3.1.js` and minified browser build; LGPL-2.1; source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/p5/-/p5-2.3.1.tgz; full license: `P5-LICENSE.txt`. The npm distribution archive is retained as `p5-2.3.1-npm-package.tgz` (SHA-256 `1725036f116c64c636a9507cf3f56635cfa4a5abeb75535f854925508c8f08f2`) with package metadata in `p5-2.3.1.package.json`.
  The complete corresponding GitHub source archive is `p5-2.3.1-github-source.tar.gz` (tag `v2.3.1`, peeled commit `a0c5805a36a03e313e5ef9990c8997b2a95d91a9`, SHA-256 `07f466ee43f1d2bc1f62a95d6485b9042070eb9e82851ec4b04f73a4f792b142`), from https://github.com/processing/p5.js/archive/refs/tags/v2.3.1.tar.gz; it contains `src/`, build scripts and the tag's package metadata.

The adapters are original project code. No upstream examples are copied.
